title: Payment processing times
summary: This document explains payment processing times for Standard transfers (settle within 12 hours after submission; show as pending until settlement completes) and Instant transfers (deliver immediately, with a $0.75 instant transfer fee). It also advises which option to choose based on delivery urgency.
faqs: How long do Standard transfers take to settle after I submit them?
Do Standard transfers appear as pending before they settle?

What is the fee for an Instant transfer?
When should I choose Standard vs Instant transfer speed?
